statement: Linux initialization obtains feature 0x09 (20 bytes), 0x20 (64 bytes) and 0x05 (41 bytes); Bluetooth responses must include valid report IDs, exact reported lengths and a trailing CRC32 using the feature seed or the kernel aborts its probe. SDL reads features 0x09 and 0x20 on enhanced Sony devices as optional, and handles a short calibration response without claiming valid hardware calibration. This establishes synthetic reply shape but not reference-device field contents.
